scenario_description:
Objective: Keep Saturday’s confirmed object-share evening able to include the indigo family rebozo on the quiet table.
Emerging Need: The outing moves from a possible salon visit to a paid table slot before the required carry-in textile tag is in place.
Decision Context: Stored textile and caption notes supply the safe handling limits and approved wording that the venue records do not contain.
Consequence: Timely handling preserves the rebozo’s future table presence without authorizing new display methods; after intake closes, the outing remains scheduled but the tag prerequisite is unavailable.

parameter.subject: Saturday object-share salon preview
parameter.body: This Saturday's after-hours object-share salon will include a quiet table for small family textiles and keepsakes. Full carry-in procedures and any table-slot paperwork will be sent only after registration is confirmed.

parameter.content: If you decide the Saturday object-share is really happening, I can meet you there with the cedar sleeve. I would rather keep the rebozo on a quiet table than make a big presentation of it.

parameter.title: Folk Art object-share evening with Celia
parameter.description: Meet Celia in the lobby and use the quiet table for the indigo family rebozo if the venue intake requirements can be met.
Registration for Saturday object-share quiet table

parameter.subject: FOAS-4227 object-share intake worksheet
parameter.body: Registration FOAS-4227 is confirmed for one quiet-table textile slot on Saturday. Carry-in textile tag status: not on file. Tags are generated only from an owner-approved caption line and handling note received at intake@folkart.example by 14:00 today; untagged carry-in objects remain in bags during the table session. No on-site tag production is available.

parameter.subject: Object-share tag queue closed for Saturday
parameter.body: The carry-in object tag queue for Saturday's salon closed at 14:00, and the table maps have gone to print. Late caption or handling notes cannot be added for this session; untagged objects may still be brought in their bags but will not receive table tags.
